data.name: Kaabir
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Kaabir means 'great' or 'big'. This name holds a significant place in Islamic history as it was the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Kaab ibn Malik Al-Ansari was one of the earliest converts to Islam and played a crucial role in the Battle of Uhud.
